entries.title: Saved website sign-ins work for more sites
entries.body: Some websites keep your sign-in only in the page itself, for as long as the page stays open. When you tick Remember as you hand a task's browser back, Infinitary now saves that too, so a later task's one click on Use my saved sign-in opens the site signed in. These sites can still end a sign-in on their own schedule, and then the page asks you to sign in again. What such a site keeps in its page can include what you typed to sign in; it stays in the same private file on this Mac as the rest of the saved sign-in, and Remove deletes it.
